title: Bound joint P112 triple recoding in seven subset-sum directions
body:
## Summary

Every finite recoding of three distinct PR3370 indicators on the seven nonzero subset-sum query rays, with readers in their triple span, has exact minimum actual-reader tariff equal to the original three terms over every coefficient field. Disjoint triple replacements retain whole-K tariff 224.

```diff
 literal P112 actual-reader bounds
- pair-span recodings; larger joint blocks unaddressed
+ all 4,960 target triples in the explicit seven-ray dictionary
+ arbitrary finite repetitions/scalings reduce to 729 support patterns
```

Only `research/p112-three-target-dictionary/` is added. The package contains the finite-support reduction, all-field argument, unchanged attributed geometry, exact receipt, two standalone implementations, controls and reproduction instructions. This answers one part of PR3463's larger-joint-block handoff. PR3383 bounds a different query self-cost. External dimensions, arbitrary rays and nonconstant/global readers remain separate. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- **Before:** no exact triple-dictionary minimum was established by the pair results. **After:** all 800 literal group types and all 729 minimal reader-support patterns give 583,200 exact bills; both implementations reproduce every minimum, minimizer count and full bill-stream digest.
- Rational Gaussian solves and packed binary ranks are checked against integer-minor support tests and explicit coordinate Gram elimination. All 35 dictionary minors establish unchanged support feasibility outside characteristic two. The retained expanded-I224 argument handles characteristic two directly.
- Seven behavioral groups cover the half-integral operator at all 12,544 literal entries, deletion, binary/rational rank separation, all F3/F5 subset-axis span requests, capacities and six actual optimized CLI corruptions. Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized direct replays, Ruff diagnostics/formatting, exact committed bytes and source-history availability pass. All three scientific commands pass from the Git-free committed export without changing its twelve files.

Replay with a private existing TMPDIR:

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-three-target-dictionary
```

Publication commit: `77f86bdc229ce812f1dad03dc44d4ed87de81cbd`. Base and submission refresh: canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6, with no guidance/input delta. SOURCES.json binds the one live canonical input and retained PR3370 fixture; no pending Git object is needed. Credit Tekalign/PR3370, Philippe Van Velzen/PR3345 and the immediate P112 predecessors and retained lineage named in the package.

This finite source-specific bound pauses the seven-ray dictionary. Native acquisition, coefficients, frames, dirty restoration, hosting, precision, complete supplier and outer transfer remain open. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker, hosted CI and full selected cold replay were not run.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

An isolated research package with an opt-in bounded replay; existing scientific inputs and verifiers are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** Package
